_meta.purpose: A curated catalogue of real SSF tournaments and groups that illustrate specific data shapes, encodings and anomalies. Intended for discovery, verifying new features, hunting anomalies — and, where useful, as a source of test fixtures. NOT a test-fixture folder: most entries exist to answer 'show me a real example of X'.
_meta.seededBy: sthlmschack-reimagined, 2026-08-08..11, while building result rendering, the women filter and prize categories

schema.groupId: SSF group id, null for tournament-level entries (/tournamentresults/table/id/{id})
schema.name: human label as it appears in the API
schema.illustrates: one line: what this entry is an example OF
schema.note: detail worth knowing — the numbers that make it useful
schema.observed: ISO date the claim was last verified against live data
schema.anomaly: true when the entry documents something broken or contradictory upstream

conventions: Every claim carries an `observed` date. SSF data drifts — a club vanished from a district listing mid-investigation on 2026-08-10 — so an unverified entry is a hypothesis, not a fact.
Counts are as-of `observed` and will move as results are published or ratings are recalculated.
Prize categories live on the GROUP but are only reachable via the tournament payload; use findTournamentGroup rather than walking one level.

entries.name: Västerås Open 2025
entries.illustrates: A group carrying all four prize types at once — the richest single example for prize work.
entries.note: 8 rating bands (R1 2094-2153 … R8 0-1783), Junior (age 0-20), Dam (bounds 0-0, unset), Veteran. 72 players; 14 are aged 60+, 3 are women, 0 are unrated. rankingAlgorithm=1 (standard).

entries.name: Lilla Västerås Open 2025
entries.illustrates: SENIOR (type 3) bounds are meaningless, and the unrated-players catch-all band.
entries.note: Veteran is declared -1--1 here but 0-50 in its sister group 16642 — same tournament, same prize. Proof the field is unused and the rule is the constant age>=60. Also carries R3 (0-1000) with 12 of 33 players unrated (rating:0) — the group that exposed the unrated-matching bug.

entries.name: Västerås Open 2025 — VETERAN 59-year-old boundary
entries.illustrates: The official SENIOR list can include a player who only turns 60 the FOLLOWING calendar year — contradicting a strict age>=60 on tournamentYear.
entries.note: Played 2025-09-19..21 (a 3-day event, no spill into 2026). Veteran (type 3, prizeCategoryId 4022). Lennarth Eriksson (born 1966) is listed, but tournamentYear - birthYear = 2025 - 1966 = 59; the next-younger (born 1967, 58) is NOT listed. Cutoff sits at born <= 1966 = turns 60 during the 2025/26 season. The other veteran category (sister group 16643, same tournament) matches age>=60 exactly, so this is the lone discrepancy. Open question for schack.se: the SENIOR reference year (season year vs calendar year vs a manual add). The SDK ships age>=60 on tournamentYear and misses just this boundary case. Official list: https://resultat.schack.se/ShowTournamentServlet?id=16642&tournamentprizecatid=4022

entries.name: Manhemknatten & Junioren 2025 — Mellanstadiet (2012-2014)
entries.illustrates: Proves AGE bands are ages computed as tournamentYear - birthYear.
entries.note: Tournament starts 2025-03-08. Bands: '2014' = 11-11, '2013' = 12-12, '2012' = 13-13. The group is populated by players born 2012-2014. Sister group 15742 (Lågstadiet) declares '2016-' = 1-9 and '2015' = 10-10.

entries.name: Stockholm Grand Prix 2025
entries.illustrates: The ONLY women's prize found carrying bounds — RESOLVED: the type-2 bounds are decorative; a women's prize is 'best woman' (female only).
entries.note: 'Dampris' 1400-2500 (prizeCategoryId 4122), usagetype=1, andlogic=-1. Resolved against resultat.schack.se: the discriminating case Yeganeh Ranjbar (unrated, age 26) IS listed under Dampris despite the 1400-2500 band, so the bounds do not filter. The SDK matches women as female-only, ignoring bounds. Still open (no live example): whether a women's prize can EVER be genuinely rating-restricted (e.g. 'bästa dam under 1600'). Official list: https://resultat.schack.se/ShowTournamentServlet?id=16129&tournamentprizecatid=4122

entries.name: Avenyn Open 2025
entries.illustrates: The largest prize-category set found — good stress test for any UI listing them.
entries.note: 23 categories: 19 rating bands + 3 age + 1 Dam. Runners-up: SM-Blixten (5864/16718, 22) and Elite Hotels Open 2026 (5684/16134, 19).

entries.name: Påskturneringen 2026
entries.illustrates: A clean rating-bands-only group; also a tournament-level thinkingTime string.
entries.note: 11 bands, R1 1575-1718 … R11 2127-2203. 145 players, 1 unrated. thinkingTime 'R 1-2: Snabb, R 3-8: Långparti' is set on the TOURNAMENT and inherited by both groups. Sister group 16135 has a single band 'Ranking_lilla' 1418-1583.

entries.name: SM i blixt 2025
entries.illustrates: rankingAlgorithm 8 = BLITZ_STANDARD_RAPID — a priority chain, not a single rating type.
entries.note: Bands are expressed in blitz ratings. 2 players in R1 (2145-2220) would be misbanded if compared on standard rating. Blitz events commonly use 8, NOT the single-type BLITZ_ELO (7).

entries.name: SM i snabbschack 2025
entries.illustrates: rankingAlgorithm 10 = RAPID_STANDARD_BLITZ; also proves prize rating bands count a FALLBACK rating.
entries.note: 7 players in R1 (2091-2209) would be misbanded on standard rating. Harald Hammarström: standard 0 (unrated) but rapid 2145 — unrated on one axis, a contender on the other. Fallback confirmed against resultat.schack.se: Torbjörn Umegård (rapid 0, standard 2063 = a FALLBACK for algo 10) IS listed under R2 (1998-2090) shown as '2063E' — so a rating prize bands a player on their fallback rating, matching the standings table. R2 official list: https://resultat.schack.se/ShowTournamentServlet?id=16584&tournamentprizecatid=4053

entries.name: SM 2026
entries.illustrates: SMCLASS (type 5) appearing as a registration restriction, never as a prize.
entries.note: Groups Mästarklassen-Elit / Mästarklassen / Klass I-III carry registrationCategories with type=5, usagetype=2 and values 0-0, 1-1, 2-2, 3-3. registrationCategories are entry restrictions, NOT prizes — distinguishable by usagetype.

entries.name: Lilla Påskturneringen 2026
entries.illustrates: A rating CAP as an entry restriction, easily confused with a rating prize.
entries.note: registrationCategories carries type=4 'Rankingspärr 1750+' 0-1750, usagetype=2. Same type as a rating prize; only usagetype separates them. Also seen on Avenyn Open, Malmö Open, Elite Hotels Open.

entries.name: Tjejträffen 2026 — Öppen
entries.illustrates: Proves PlayerInfoDto.sex 1 = FEMALE (the SDK's JSDoc once claimed the reverse).
entries.note: All 32 players are sex=1. Sister group 17725 (Nybörjar) is 13/13. A girls-only event is the only clean way to pin the encoding. Also the case where a 'women only' filter must be HIDDEN — filtering to the whole field is a no-op.

entries.name: Bulk school-club registrations
entries.illustrates: sex=2 means UNRECORDED, not female — a gender mix, mostly bulk school registrations.
entries.note: 18 of 5174 sampled standings rows. Names are mixed (Tove Parck, Amanda Karlsson, yusef huseyin, David Mehrabi) plus a literal 'NN NN'. 14 come from IES Liljeholmen / IES Helsingborg / IES Österåker / Wallbergsskolan. Consequence: a few real girls are invisible to any gender filter. sex=-1 appears only on the synthetic walkover row (member -100).

entries.name: Seniorserien VT 24, klass 4
entries.illustrates: A small mixed field with senior women — and the largest cluster of 0-0 walkovers found.
entries.note: 11 players, 4 women (Elfia Salejeva, Vida Radon, Brita Trybom, Mari-Anne Elsasdotter — all senior, which is why a gender filter must not be labelled 'girls'). 21 NO_WIN_WO rows across rounds. No prize categories.

entries.name: Svarta Hästen KM 2025
entries.illustrates: The ONLY POSTPONED (code 100) found in a standard individual tournament.
entries.note: 1 row, round 6. Across 467 sampled groups, 296 of 297 POSTPONED rows are in Schackfyran groups (13613 has 50, 13641 has 44, 18056 has 126, 18057 has 71). Postponed carries homeResult=awayResult=0, so a naive 0-0 'unplayed' check swallows it.

entries.name: NO_WIN_WO (-3) clusters
entries.illustrates: 0-0 double forfeits — the dominant real-world case of a legitimately-zero result.
entries.note: Groups 13633 (21 rows), 13605 (10), 13650 (1), 5685 (1). Renders as '0 - 0 w.o'. These plus 0-0 adj are the ~36 rows in 467 groups that a 0-0-first check wrongly flattens to a dash.

entries.name: KM 2015/2016
entries.illustrates: BOTH_NO_RESULT (-10), rendered '0 - 0 adj' / Swedish 'domslut'.
entries.note: Round 4, Daniel Jildholt vs Peter Holmgren. Rare: 2 occurrences in 467 groups. NOTE the Swedish term is 'domslut' (a ruling), NOT 'avbruten' — confirmed against resultat.schack.se. 'adj' abbreviates adjudicated, not adjourned.

entries.name: Schackfyran group with unset game codes
entries.illustrates: games[0].result = NOT_SET (-100) while the row still carries real points.
entries.note: Rounds 1/4/5 have homeResult 2.0 / awayResult 2.0 with code -100 — a Schackfyran draw (3-2-1 point system) whose game code was never set. Also group 5673 (rounds 1/5). Means NOT_SET must mean 'this code carries no information', not 'no result exists'; fall back to the row's points.

entries.name: Team tournament — games[0] is board 1
entries.illustrates: On a team row, games[] holds the boards and homeResult/awayResult holds the MATCH score.
entries.note: Round 1, match 3 (38439 vs 38647): 5 boards with results [1,1,1,-1,0] and a match score of 1.5-3.5. Reading games[0].result gives '1 - 0' — plausible and completely wrong. Round 7 additionally has 5 boards all NOT_SET with a 5-0 match score.

entries.name: Schackfyran (tournament type 9)
entries.illustrates: Identity-wise a team event, but individually paired — isTeamTournament true, isTeamPairing false.
entries.note: No team-standings endpoint exists upstream for this format. Groups 3941, 5673, 13613, 13641, 13608, 13656 are examples. Uses the 3-2-1 point system, so a '2 - 2' row is a draw. Nearly all POSTPONED rows live here.

entries.name: Stockholm JGP 2026 — open division
entries.illustrates: A season assembled from many groups, filtered by Stockholm district membership.
entries.note: Five counting tournaments (Tyresö, Trojanska Hästen Vår, SIS Chess, Wasa, SS 4 Springare); the girls division adds Tjejträffen for six. Eligibility is per-player via club -> district 5821 with active=1, NOT via girls-only groups: the girls series scores the same mixed groups as the open one.

entries.name: Manhems Schackvecka 2019 — GM
entries.illustrates: A round-robin (Berger) group — pairingSystemMember = BERGER, where the SDK ranks by Sonneborn-Berger, not Buchholz.
entries.note: 10 players, all-play-all GM group. Round-robin is where getRoundStandings uses the SB tie-break chain (Buchholz is FIDE-invalid here). Contrast with a Swiss group like 15816 (SSF Buchholz).

entries.name: Stockholmsserien 2011/2012 — div IV
entries.illustrates: An old team event with incomplete/legacy round data — the team-standings self-verification downgrade case.
entries.note: type=2 (ALLSVENSKAN, team). Legacy season whose round data is incomplete / uses an older match-point convention, so getRoundStandings self-verifies the reconstructed order against the official table and honestly downgrades to estimated rather than over-claiming 'exact'.

entries.name: Skollags-SM 2026
entries.illustrates: A real team school championship encoded as type=2 (ALLSVENSKAN), NOT type=5 — a classification reality check.
entries.note: isTeamTournament true. The intuitive 'SCHOOL_SM = type 5' is wrong for the TEAM Skol-SM: it uses type=2. Pair with skol-sm-2023 (type=5, individual) to see the distinction.

entries.name: Skol-SM 2023
entries.illustrates: type=5 (SCHOOL_SM) as an INDIVIDUAL event (playerListType=-1) — the counterpart to the type-2 team Skol-SM.
entries.note: isTeamTournament false. Confirms type 5 is individual here, so tournament type alone does not imply team vs individual — pair with skollags-sm-2026-team-type-2.
